name: read_file
description: Reads the content of a text file. Also supports reading only a specific range of lines, with startLine/endLine or with offset/limit. A large file is still capped to a context ceiling: the response always explains how to retrieve the rest (a subsequent offset/limit, or grep_search).

path.description: The relative or absolute path of the file to read.

startLine.description: The line to start reading from (1-indexed, optional).

endLine.description: The line to stop reading at (1-indexed, inclusive, optional).

offset.description: The line to start reading from (1-indexed, optional). An alternative to startLine, meant for pagination: use it together with limit to request the next chunk of a file that's too large.

limit.description: Number of lines to read starting from offset (optional, default: to end of file).
